name: Zumpo/Trios card
description: A Trios card: one to three shapes (the Shape property sets all of them), its state, and an optional badge: Hint on a hinted card, the finder’s initials on a found one. Hinted marks a card of a trio a hint gave away, with a lime ring and a lime Hint badge; Hover is the pointer over a card that can be picked, lifted without an outline, so it never looks picked.

Shape.default: Zumpo/Trios shape / Shape=Circle, Fill=Solid, Colour=Coral, Stripes=Fine
